description: This file contains functions for resolving and normalizing conversation-related identifiers and context within a command handling flow, specifically for ACP commands. It imports modules for conversation ID normalization and message binding resolution, and provides exported functions to obtain channel, account ID, thread ID, conversation ID, parent conversation ID, and binding context based on command parameters.

methods.description: Resolves the channel string for an ACP command based on the message context and command channel, normalizing and converting to lowercase.

methods.description: Resolves the account ID associated with an ACP command message.

methods.description: Resolves the thread ID from the message context.

methods.description: Private helper function that resolves the conversation reference, including conversation and optional parent conversation IDs, from the command parameters.

methods.description: Obtains the conversation ID from the conversation reference.

methods.description: Builds the full binding context including channel, account ID, thread ID, and conversation IDs for an ACP command.
